name: sway-tree-navigation
title: Sway Tree Navigation
description: A nested folder hierarchy where tree branches sway organically with delayed momentum when expanded or hovered.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Organic
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Expandable Branch Inspection: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
